newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar weaker, AA dominates thin trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar weaker, AA dominates thin trade.

text.p: White sugar futures got off to a slow start on Friday with traders once again waiting for New York to break its range to drag the London market out of its lethargy.
Nearby positions edged lower in light dealings and one large against actuals trade between a commission and trade house provided nearly all the session volume.
At 1240 GMT May was down 70 cents at $306.00 and August down 30 cents at $305.00. The AA accounted for 183 of the 197 lots posted on the board.
Libya has postponed its tender to buy white sugar until Monday, market sources said.
Just 27 lots were traded on the Paris market, with May down $1.00 at $305.50.
